id.description: Shard path relative to repo root, without .json. File location and identity must match.

language.description: Primary language, or 'any' for cross-language/platform gotchas.

kind.description: code-pattern: detectable in source. environment: OS/service/PATH-level. build: build-system/tooling. runtime: only manifests when running. config: config-file content.

version_range.description: Normalized semver range; native range preserved in source_range.

symptoms.description: What the developer observes — error text fragments, behaviors, red herrings.

kind.description: ast/semantic reserved for future schema versions.

file_glob.description: Restrict detection to matching files, e.g. '*.ps1'.

detection.description: Omit for gotchas not detectable by scanning source (kind: environment/runtime).

error_signatures.description: Regexes matched against observed error output.

fix_snippet.description: Snippet id (path under snippets/, no extension).

explanation.description: Root cause + fix. The payload shown to the AI client.

diagnosis.description: How to confirm this is the cause before applying the fix.

source.description: URL or repo-relative doc path this was derived from.
